newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Komercni opens Slovak Kosice branch Wed.
newsitem.headline: Komercni opens Slovak Kosice branch Wed.

text.p: Prague-based Komercni Banka a.s. said on Tuesday it would open its second outlet in Slovakia on Wednesday with a branch in the eastern city of Kosice.

In a statement, Komercni said the new branch would help support mutual trade between the former federation partners of Slovakia and the Czech Republic, which split into fully independent states in 1993.
The new branch's services would be available to commericial subjects and individuals, it said.
The first Slovak branch has been operating in the capital city Bratislava. The Kosice outlet will be registered under Komercni's Slovak subsidiary, Komercni Banka Bratislava a.s..
A third Slovak branch in the central city of Banska Bystrica is to open in April, it said.
